what: When you hover over menu text, each letter jitters up and down with sin(16t + index × .35π). The jitter height rises to 3px in .075s sine.inOut then settles to 0 in .4s sine.inOut, so the line of text dances in one quick shudder. The phase is random on each hover

options.peak: Tremor height (px), default 3 — the original uses 5 on the Japanese screen
options.step: Phase offset between characters (× π), default .35

note: Not applied on touch devices or reduced-motion settings (the original skips it on phones too)

from.where: shared.js dance (header menu · drawer menu · footer menu links) — original dA (js-danceButton)
